title: Current continuation rules and next work
summary: Current source baseline is Workbench dev14. Continue the Workbench itself, not Coding Intentions. Preserve the full Rexx object through internal tooling and instrumentation, and challenge every new flattening/helper layer: projection belongs at an explicit external edge. GitHub package source is authoritative for admitted Workbench work; Library is checked for newer candidate deliveries before starting a new increment.
invariants: Target component is ooRexx LLM Coding Workbench.
Avoid modifying Coding Intentions unless explicitly assigned; it is under parallel development.
Do not reintroduce a Python semantic controller merely to inspect or marshal objects already available in Rexx.
Before coding, check Library and current GitHub source to avoid duplicating already-admitted work.
When qualification cannot be rerun, record the limitation instead of upgrading evidence by assertion.
procedure: Check Library for a candidate newer than the GitHub Workbench source.
Inspect the current GitHub package and sphere before changing code.
Make the smallest Workbench-owned increment that preserves authority boundaries.
Run the strongest available qualification and record exactly what was and was not executed.
Update this sphere when an architectural invariant, authority boundary or accepted baseline changes.
